title: Day of the Week
summary: For a given date, provide the day of the week.
statement: For a given date, provide the day of the week. The date is specified by day, month, and year. The output should be one of the days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, or Saturday. The reference date January 1, 1971, is a Friday.
constraints: The date is valid and lies from 1971 through 2100.
Return the full English weekday name.
reference_solution:
def weekday_name(day, month, year):
 names=['Friday','Saturday','Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday'];days=0
 for y in range(1971,year):days+=366 if y%400==0 or y%4==0 and y%100!=0 else 365
 lengths=[31,28+(year%400==0 or year%4==0 and year%100!=0),31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]
 days+=sum(lengths[:month-1])+day-1
 return names[days%7]
